title_zh: 微信回应 iPhone Duo 适配：正积极推进，将尽快更新
content_zh:
苹果首款折叠屏手机 iPhone Duo 将于 10 月 23 日正式开售，微信适配问题也在发售前夕冲上热搜。

据第一财经报道，腾讯客服回应称，微信正在积极推进苹果可折叠设备的适配，将尽快推出相关更新，并持续优化使用体验。不过，具体进度和更新时间暂未明确。

在实际体验 iPhone Duo 时，爱范儿也发现，微信在 iPhone Duo 上的界面适配仍不到位，展开内屏后暂时无法充分利用大屏空间。

🔗 相关阅读：首发｜我们用了一周的 iPhone Duo，这里有你关心的一切
title_en: Tencent Working to Optimize WeChat for Upcoming iPhone Duo
content_en:
Tencent has confirmed it is actively adapting WeChat for Apple’s first foldable device, the iPhone Duo, ahead of the smartphone's official launch on October 23.

Addressing user concerns, Tencent customer support stated that an updated version of the messaging app will be released as soon as possible to enhance the overall experience. However, a specific rollout timeline has not yet been announced.

Early hands-on reviews indicate that WeChat's current UI is not yet fully optimized for the iPhone Duo, leaving the expanded inner screen space underutilized.

title_zh: 奥迪中国换帅，前奇瑞高管张俊将接任总裁
content_zh:
奥迪宣布，自 11 月 1 日起，张俊（Jeff Zhang）将出任奥迪中国总裁，接替 Johannes Roscheck。后者将返回德国。

据路透社报道，张俊最近曾任奇瑞品牌海外业务 CEO。与他共同领导中国业务的 Rolf Michl 将于同日出任奥迪中国 COO；Michl 此前担任 Audi Sport GmbH 董事总经理。

此次换帅发生在奥迪面临中国市场竞争和销量压力之际。奥迪 CEO Gernot Döllner 表示，新团队的目标是贯彻公司战略，更快回应客户需求，并持续增强竞争力。
title_en: Audi Appoints Former Chery Executive Jeff Zhang as China President
content_en:
Audi has announced a major executive reshuffle in China, naming Jeff Zhang as President of Audi China, effective November 1. Zhang, who previously served as CEO of Chery's overseas division, succeeds Johannes Roscheck, who will return to Germany.

Simultaneously, Rolf Michl, former Managing Director of Audi Sport GmbH, will assume the role of Chief Operating Officer for Audi China to co-lead local operations.

The leadership change comes as Audi navigates escalating market competition and sales pressures in China. Audi CEO Gernot Döllner noted that the new executive team aims to accelerate strategic execution, respond faster to customer demands, and strengthen the brand's market competitiveness.

title_zh: eBay 再裁约 1000 个岗位，年内第二轮收缩
content_zh:
据路透社 10 月 21 日报道，eBay CEO Jamie Iannone 在内部备忘录中告知员工，公司将裁减约 9% 的岗位，以简化运营，并把资源转向增长最快的业务。eBay 发言人向路透社确认了裁员。

界面新闻援引公司向媒体的表态称，此次涉及约 1000—1100 个岗位。公司希望让人员与资源配置更贴合战略重点。

这是 eBay 今年第二轮裁员。2 月，公司已裁减约 800 人，约占当时员工总数的 6%。近年 eBay 将业务重点转向经过鉴定的奢侈品、收藏品和翻新商品，争取愿意为高价值物品付费的爱好者。
title_en: eBay Cuts Over 1,000 Jobs in Second Round of Layoffs This Year
content_en:
eBay is downsizing its workforce for the second time this year, slashing roughly 1,000 to 1,100 positions—about 9% of its total headcount—to streamline operations and refocus resources on core growth areas.

In an internal memo on October 21, CEO Jamie Iannone informed employees that the workforce reduction aims to better align organizational capacity with strategic priorities. A company spokesperson subsequently confirmed the move.

This follows a previous round of layoffs in February, where eBay eliminated around 800 roles (6% of its workforce). The e-commerce giant has been shifting its strategic focus toward high-value categories, including authenticated luxury goods, collectibles, and refurbished items.

title_zh: 比亚迪杨冬生：L3 级自动驾驶可能在 2028 年落地
content_zh:
据第一财经报道，比亚迪集团高级副总裁、汽车新技术研究院院长杨冬生在 10 月 21 日的世界智能网联汽车大会上表示，L3 级有条件自动驾驶有希望在 2028 年落地。

对于更高级别的自动驾驶，他判断，经过技术迭代，可能在此基础上再过 1—2 年落地。
title_en: BYD Executive Predicts L3 Autonomous Driving Commercialization by 2028
content_en:
BYD Senior Vice President and Head of Automotive New Technology Research Institute Yang Dongsheng stated at the World Intelligent Connected Vehicles Conference that Level 3 (L3) conditional autonomous driving is expected to achieve commercial deployment by 2028.

Looking further ahead, Yang projected that higher levels of autonomous driving could follow relatively quickly, reaching commercialization within one to two years after L3 technology matures.

title_zh: 特斯拉三季度净利降 43%，管理层仍强调 FSD 技术领先
content_zh:
特斯拉于当地时间 10 月 21 日公布三季度业绩：营收 280.46 亿美元，同比基本持平；GAAP 归母净利润 7.87 亿美元，同比下降 43%。公司将营业利润下滑归因于 AI 与研发投入增加、监管积分收入减少，以及股权激励等费用上升。

主要业务和现金流表现如下：

在电话会上，CFO Vaibhav Taneja 称，FSD 的技术优势是目前其他中国车企所不具备的，公司仍在争取中国监管机构给予更广泛批准。马斯克则将 FSD 称为车辆需求增长的最大驱动力。财报显示，FSD 活跃付费用户增至 174 万，同比增长 67%。

管理层将全年资本开支指引调整为约 200 亿美元，计划主要用经营现金流提供资金。
title_en: Tesla's Q3 Net Profit Drops 43% Amid R&D Spending, Management Reaffirms FSD Lead
content_en:
Tesla reported its third-quarter financial results, recording revenue of $28.05 billion—roughly flat year-over-year—and a 43% drop in GAAP net profit to $787 million. The company attributed the decline in operating profit to increased investments in AI and R&D, reduced regulatory credit revenue, and higher stock-based compensation expenses.

Despite earnings pressure, management emphasized the competitive edge of its Full Self-Driving (FSD) technology. CFO Vaibhav Taneja highlighted that FSD maintains a distinct advantage over Chinese automotive rivals as Tesla continues to seek broader regulatory approvals in China. CEO Elon Musk called FSD the strongest catalyst for vehicle demand growth, noting that active paid users surged 67% year-over-year to 1.74 million.

Tesla also adjusted its full-year capital expenditure guidance to approximately $20 billion, which it plans to fund primarily through operating cash flow.

title_zh: 王兴兴：物理 AI 已有突破苗头，难点在模型与机器人对齐
content_zh:
在 10 月 22 日举行的 2026 世界物理 AI 大会暨宇树合作伙伴生态大会上，宇树科技创始人王兴兴表示，物理 AI 已经看到被「击穿」的苗头，相关突破可能在未来 1—2 年或 2—3 年出现。

据《科创板日报》报道，他认为，几乎所有人对 AI 的重视程度和信仰都还不够，其中也包括他自己。

谈及进展的依据，王兴兴在主旨演讲中称，对于顶尖大模型公司，某种意义上，内部已经基本实现模型的自进化：模型自己写程序、采集数据，人只需要适当引导和参与。

他同时区分了技术突破与普遍应用的时间。王兴兴表示，从技术突破扩散到每个人都能使用，需要 5—10 年，因此人们对这些进展的感受还不那么深刻。

在他看来，具身智能迈过「ChatGPT 时刻」的最核心挑战，是 AI 模型的输入输出与真实机器人的对齐。至于具体落地顺序，他判断商业服务场景会比家庭、工业领域更快。

第一财经的现场报道还记录了一项内部测试：王兴兴称，把 GPT-6 部署到机器人上，在没有为洗笔、换色专门编写程序的情况下，机器人能观察旁边的颜料盘，自行清洗画笔并继续绘画。他认为，大模型已能解决部分规划问题，但精细装配和复杂物体交互仍有大量工程难点。

宇树也在内部预研机器人自进化流程：让模型搜集论文、写代码，先在仿真中训练、再到真实环境测试，由 AI 或人打分后反馈给模型，继续改写代码与方案。他在演讲结尾说，自己「真的很害怕浪费每一天」，行业机会很多，竞争也很激烈。
title_en: Physical AI on the Verge of Breakthroughs, Says Unitree Founder
content_en:
At the 2026 World Physical AI Conference, Unitree Robotics founder Wang Xingxing stated that physical AI is on the verge of major breakthroughs, with key technical advancements likely to emerge within the next one to three years. However, he noted that widespread consumer application could take five to ten years to fully materialize.

According to Wang, the primary hurdle preventing embodied AI from reaching its "ChatGPT moment" is aligning AI model inputs and outputs with physical robot hardware. In terms of deployment, he expects commercial service sectors to adopt the technology faster than home or industrial environments.

Highlighting internal testing, Wang noted that advanced models have demonstrated autonomous planning capabilities, such as a robot inspecting paint palettes and cleaning its own brushes without pre-programmed instructions. Despite promising self-evolution experiments, he stressed that fine assembly and complex object interactions remain major engineering hurdles in a rapidly competing market.

title_zh: 宝马与中国信通院续签合作，聚焦 AI 与下一代通信技术
content_zh:
宝马集团在 2026 世界智能网联汽车大会上宣布，宝马（中国）服务有限公司与中国信息通信研究院续签合作备忘录，将围绕下一代通信技术、人工智能及其他前沿技术深化合作。

双方于 2019 年首次签署合作协议。此次续签的合作内容包括产业趋势研判、政策与标准研究、联合研究和产业生态共建。

宝马表示，中国团队正承担更多需求定义、软件开发、测试验证和量产应用工作。面向中国市场打造的新世代 BMW iX3 与 BMW i3，将结合宝马全球工程体系与中国伙伴在电动化、智能驾驶、数字化方面的技术。
title_en: BMW Renews Partnership with CAICT to Advance AI and Next-Gen Telecom
content_en:
At the 2026 World Intelligent Connected Vehicles Conference, BMW Group announced that BMW (China) Services has renewed its Memorandum of Understanding with the China Academy of Information and Communications Technology (CAICT). The renewed partnership will focus on deepening collaboration in next-generation communication technologies, artificial intelligence, and other cutting-edge fields.

First partnered in 2019, the two organizations will expand their joint efforts to encompass industry trend analysis, policy and standards research, joint studies, and ecosystem building.

BMW highlighted the growing role of its local engineering team in China, which is taking on broader responsibilities across software development, testing, and mass production. Upcoming models tailored for the Chinese market, including the next-generation BMW iX3 and BMW i3, will integrate BMW's global engineering expertise with local innovations in electrification, autonomous driving, and digital technology.

title_zh: OpenAI 据报接近敲定最高 300 亿美元融资，投前估值 1.25 万亿美元
content_zh:
据 CNBC 援引知情人士报道，OpenAI 接近敲定一轮最高 300 亿美元的融资，由阿联酋投资者与 Coatue 牵头，投前估值为 1.25 万亿美元。该估值不包含本轮新募集的资金。

知情人士称，这轮融资被定位为潜在 IPO 前的过桥融资。OpenAI 已于 10 月 22 日告知投资者，希望在下周末前完成签署，但最终融资规模仍在确定中。公司在 9 月收到投资者提议后启动了新一轮融资讨论。

除股权融资外，OpenAI 还在谈判一项商业协议，以获得更多来自阿联酋的算力。公司今年 6 月已向美国证券交易委员会秘密提交招股文件，尚未公布具体上市时间；CFO Sarah Friar 曾向员工表示，公司将在 2027 年上市。
title_en: OpenAI Nears $30 Billion Bridge Funding at $1.25 Trillion Valuation Ahead of Targeted IPO
content_en:
OpenAI is nearing the completion of a massive funding round of up to $30 billion led by UAE investors and Coatue, according to CNBC citing people familiar with the matter. The pre-money valuation stands at $1.25 trillion, excluding the new capital being raised.

Positioned as a bridge financing ahead of a potential initial public offering (IPO), OpenAI informed investors on October 22 that it aims to finalize the deal by late next week, though the final size remains under negotiation. Alongside equity funding, OpenAI is also negotiating a commercial deal to secure additional computing power from the UAE.

The AI giant confidentially submitted its IPO filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission in June. While an official timeline has not been disclosed, CFO Sarah Friar previously told employees the company targets a public listing in 2027.

title_zh: 西部数据季度营收增 55%，下季收入指引升至约 51 亿美元
content_zh:
西部数据公布截至 10 月 2 日的 2027 财年第一财季业绩：营收 43.81 亿美元，同比增长 55%、环比增长 17%；按 GAAP 口径，归属普通股股东的稀释净利润为 17.79 亿美元，同比增长 54%，稀释每股收益为 4.63 美元。

盈利能力继续提高：GAAP 毛利率为 57.8%，去年同期为 43.5%；营业利润为 20.46 亿美元，同比增长 158%。按非 GAAP 口径，毛利率为 58.1%，稀释每股收益为 4.64 美元。公司当季经营现金流为 16 亿美元，自由现金流为 13.8 亿美元。

CFO Kris Sennesael 表示，本季业务保持增长，出货容量增长与定价改善推动业绩。公司预计第二财季营收为 51 亿美元、上下浮动 1 亿美元，非 GAAP 毛利率为 60%—61%，稀释每股收益为 5.80 美元、上下浮动 0.20 美元。

西部数据还将季度股息提高 17% 至每股 0.175 美元，计划于 12 月 17 日向 12 月 4 日收盘时在册的股东派发。
title_en: Western Digital Reports 55% Revenue Jump, Raises Next-Quarter Guidance to $5.1 Billion
content_en:
Western Digital posted strong financial results for its first fiscal quarter ended October 2, with revenue surging 55% year-over-year and 17% sequentially to $4.381 billion. GAAP net income reached $1.779 billion, up 54% from a year earlier, delivering diluted earnings per share of $4.63.

Profitability expanded significantly, driven by higher shipment capacity and improved pricing. GAAP gross margin climbed to 57.8% from 43.5% in the prior-year period, while operating income skyrocketed 158% to $2.046 billion. Non-GAAP gross margin stood at 58.1% with diluted EPS at $4.64. The company generated $1.6 billion in operating cash flow and $1.38 billion in free cash flow during the quarter.

Looking ahead, Western Digital expects second-quarter revenue of approximately $5.1 billion (±$100 million), with non-GAAP gross margin reaching 60%–61% and diluted EPS projected at $5.80 (±$0.20). Additionally, the company announced a 17% increase in its quarterly dividend to $0.175 per share, payable on December 17 to shareholders of record as of December 4.

title_zh: 💡 马斯克：未来人形机器人的数量将超过人类
content_zh:
在特斯拉三季度财报电话会上，马斯克重申，他相信 Optimus 及整个人形机器人品类将成为全球最大的产品。他说：

他的理由是，机器人的实用性大致由机电灵巧程度、AI 软件和 AI 芯片三者相乘决定；他认为，三方面的改进彼此叠加，加上机器人参与制造下一批机器人的循环，将推动产能和能力快速增长。

马斯克也提醒，Optimus 仍需要解决手部耐用性、灵巧性、AI 与使用寿命等问题。手要能长期反复工作，也要足够柔软，抓取精细物品时不能损坏传感器。他预计到 2027 年末，这些条件才可能基本到位，向特斯拉以外企业交付。

谈到训练方法，他表示，机器人没有汽车那样庞大的现成数据采集车队，需要先制造上万台机器人，在 Optimus Academy 中练习各种任务，再把经验用于改进模型。机器人要先观察人类，再在仿真和现实环境中反复练习；只看别人踢球，不代表自己就会踢球。

至于最初的用途，他认为应优先承担工业场景中危险、重复、需要全天候进行的任务，随着产量扩大，再面向家庭。
title_en: Elon Musk Predicts Humanoid Robots Will Outnumber Humans
content_en:
During Tesla's Q3 earnings call, Elon Musk reiterated his vision that Optimus and humanoid robots will eventually become the world's largest product category, predicting their population will ultimately surpass that of humans.

Musk explained that a robot's overall utility depends on the combined advancements in electromechanical dexterity, AI software, and specialized AI chips. He emphasized that utilizing robots to manufacture future generations of robots will create a compounding feedback loop, driving exponential growth in both production capacity and operational capabilities.

However, several technical hurdles remain before commercial viability. Key challenges include improving hand durability, fine motor skills, AI reasoning, and overall operating lifespan. Musk expects these development milestones to be met by late 2027, paving the way for commercial deliveries outside of Tesla.

To accelerate training, Tesla plans to deploy tens of thousands of robots to an internal program called "Optimus Academy." There, the robots will observe human behavior and continuously refine their skills through practice in both simulated and real-world environments.

Initial deployments will prioritize hazardous, repetitive, and 24/7 industrial tasks before expanding into consumer homes as production scales up.

title_zh: 乐奇 Rokid Color 意外曝光，彩显 AI 眼镜或将亮相
content_zh:
据 AR 圈报道，10 月 22 日，乐奇 Rokid 创始人祝铭明（Misa）发布的一条朋友圈视频，意外曝光了疑似彩显 AI 眼镜的产品名称和 Logo，标识中出现「Rokid Color」字样。

从视频画面来看，这段内容疑似由 AI 眼镜上的摄像头拍摄。视频底部的产品水印与乐奇现有产品的水印不同，Logo 中还出现了一个马头图案，其具体含义暂不清楚。由于原视频中的 Logo 尺寸较小，相关报道还使用 AI 技术对其进行了还原，仅供参考。

「Rokid Color」这一名称及其配色，或暗示该产品将采用彩色显示方案。乐奇将于 10 月 27 日举办发布会，这款疑似彩显 AI 眼镜或有望亮相。
title_en: Rokid Color Leaked Ahead of Launch, Hinting at Color Display AI Glasses
content_en:
A social media post by Rokid founder Zhu Mingming (Misa) has accidentally revealed what appears to be a new AI smart glasses product named "Rokid Color."

The leaked footage, apparently recorded directly through the glasses' built-in camera, featured a novel watermark and a distinct horse-head logo. The product name and branding strongly suggest that the wearable device will feature a full-color display solution.

Rokid has scheduled an official launch event for October 27, where the full-color AI smart glasses are expected to make their public debut.

title_zh: 高德将为 iPhone Duo 推出分屏导航，车道与远方路线并排显示
content_zh:
高德宣布完成对 iPhone Duo 折叠形态的适配，并将推出分屏导航功能：左侧显示车道级导航，右侧显示常规地图上的前方路线与路况。两种视野并排呈现，分别承担眼前的车道引导和更远距离的路线查看。

目前，高德已支持随内外屏切换、设备方向变化自动调整界面布局。地点探索也采用双栏设计，用户可在左侧浏览地点、扫街榜榜单及推荐信息，同时在右侧查看餐厅位置；还可将高德与其他应用分屏显示。

按高德官方说明，将 App 更新至最新版本即可体验已有适配；驾车分屏导航将在后续更新中上线。高德称，这是首个面向可折叠 iPhone 的分屏导航功能。
title_en: Amap Unveils Industry-First Split-Screen Navigation for Foldable iPhone Duo
content_en:
Amap (Gaode Maps) has announced UI adaptation for the foldable "iPhone Duo," introducing a brand-new split-screen navigation experience. The innovative layout presents precise lane-level guidance on the left panel while displaying long-range route overviews and traffic conditions on the right.

The interface dynamically adjusts to display switches and orientation changes. Additionally, a dual-column layout allows users to browse local recommendations on one side while viewing location maps on the other, alongside support for side-by-side multitasking with other applications.

While basic UI adaptations are available in the latest app update, the dedicated split-screen driving navigation feature will roll out in an upcoming release.

title_zh: 蘑菇灯 Mori 会看人、会跳舞，创始版售价 649 美元
content_zh:
初创公司 OKA 推出首款产品 Mori：一盏带有摄像头、麦克风和活动头部的蘑菇形机器人灯。有人回家时，它会抬头、发出轻声并做出动作；触碰顶部后，面部缩回灯罩，进入自然声景与灯光陪伴模式。

据 WIRED 对 CEO Hua Wang 的采访，Mori 可以随着音乐起舞、回应人的动作，并引导呼吸练习，但暂时不支持用语音控制智能家居、播放指定歌曲或查询天气。其 AI 在设备本地处理图像和声音，原始文件随后丢弃；面部特征数据加密保存在设备上，不上传云端。

创始版于 10 月 22 日开售，限量数百台，售价 649 美元，包含两年保修和两年订阅。标准版售价 799 美元，不含订阅服务；呼吸练习可免费使用，自然声景则需要订阅。按公司说明，头部缩回时摄像头关闭，双击顶部可关闭麦克风。
title_en: OKA Unveils Mori: A $649 Interactive Mushroom Lamp That Dances and Reacts to You
content_en:
Startup OKA has introduced its debut product, Mori, a mushroom-shaped robotic lamp featuring a camera, microphone, and motorized head. Designed for personal companion-style interaction, Mori looks up, makes gentle sounds, and moves subtly when someone enters the room. Tapping its top retracts its face into the lampshade, transitioning it into a relaxing soundscape and ambient light mode.

Powered by local AI, Mori can dance to music, respond to physical movements, and guide breathing exercises. However, it does not currently function as a traditional smart assistant—it cannot control smart home devices, play specific songs, or offer weather reports. To protect privacy, all audio and visual data are processed locally and promptly deleted, with encrypted facial features stored exclusively on the device.

The limited Founder Edition launched on October 22 for $649, bundling a two-year warranty and subscription service. A standard version will later sell for $799 without the subscription. For physical privacy controls, retracting the lamp head automatically shuts off the camera, while a quick double-tap on top mutes the microphone.

title_zh: 影石推出更便宜的无线麦克风，保留彩色墨水屏、改用存储卡备份
content_zh:
影石发布 Insta360 Mic，定位介于 Mic Air 和 Mic Pro 之间。新款保留正面的 1.22 英寸六色电子墨水屏，可显示照片、Logo 或纯色；按 The Verge 报道，单发射器海外售价为 79.99 美元，双发射器、接收器及充电盒套装为 249.99 美元。

与 Mic Pro 的三麦克风阵列相比，新款采用单麦克风，只提供全指向拾音。发射器重量为 19.4g，单次最长续航由 Mic Pro 的 10 小时增至 13 小时，配合充电盒可达 34 小时。

新款没有内置存储，可插入 microSD 卡进行备份录音。它保留 AI 降噪和自动增益控制，配接收器最远传输距离为 400 米，也能通过蓝牙连接手机及部分影石相机。
title_en: Insta360 Debuts Affordable Wireless Mic with E-Ink Screen and MicroSD Backup
content_en:
Insta360 has officially launched the Insta360 Mic, a mid-range wireless microphone positioned between its Mic Air and Mic Pro models. The new device retains the series' distinctive 1.22-inch six-color E-Ink display, which can display photos, logos, or custom colors. According to reports, the standalone transmitter is priced at $79.99, while a full bundle featuring two transmitters, a receiver, and a charging case costs $249.99.

Unlike the flagship Mic Pro's three-microphone array, the new model uses a single omnidirectional microphone. Despite the change, it weighs just 19.4 grams and improves single-charge battery life from 10 hours to 13 hours, reaching up to 34 hours when paired with the charging case.

To keep costs down, built-in storage has been replaced with a microSD card slot for local backup recordings. The microphone keeps essential features like AI noise cancellation and auto gain control, offering up to a 400-meter range with the receiver, as well as direct Bluetooth connectivity for smartphones and select Insta360 cameras.

title_zh: OpenAI 决策 API 正式开放，一次可处理 400 个判断问题
content_zh:
OpenAI 于 10 月 22 日宣布，Decisions API 结束公开测试并正式开放，目前使用 GPT-6 Luna 模型。它面向内容分类、请求路由和任务优先级排序等场景，直接返回条件成立的概率、预设选项或评分。

相较公开测试阶段，单次请求支持的问题数由 200 个增至 400 个，并新增共享输入缓存、问题指令内附图和直接传入 JSON 等能力。官方称，这类判断任务的响应速度约为 Responses API 的 10 倍。

该接口的未缓存输入价格为每百万 token 0.10 美元，不收取输出 token 费用；共享输入命中缓存可享折扣。它也能接入 GPT-Live，在用户说话或语音模型输出时触发判断。
title_en: OpenAI Launches Decisions API for High-Speed Batch Logic Processing
content_en:
OpenAI officially released its Decisions API out of public beta on October 22, powered by the GPT-6 Luna model. Targeted at tasks such as content classification, request routing, and task prioritization, the API simplifies logic flows by directly returning probability estimates, preset options, or numerical scores.

Compared to its beta version, the production release increases the single-request limit from 200 to 400 decision queries. It also introduces shared input caching, image support within instruction prompts, and direct JSON input processing. OpenAI claims the API responds roughly 10 times faster than the standard Responses API for decision-making tasks.

The API is priced at $0.10 per million uncached input tokens with no charge for output tokens, along with discounts for cached input hits. Additionally, it can integrate with GPT-Live to perform real-time evaluations during active voice streams.

title_zh: 一加 Ace 7 系列定档 10 月 29 日，双路风冷分别吹向芯片与后盖
content_zh:
一加 Ace 7 系列新品发布会定于 10 月 29 日 19:00 举行，官方定档海报已公布新机外观。

一加中国区总裁李杰介绍，新机采用「双路冰河风冷系统」：一路出风直吹芯片，另一路吹过后盖，分别处理性能释放与握持区域发热。散热结构还采用游戏显卡同类的塔式鳍片，并让风扇与温控算法协同工作。

李杰将维持游戏帧率和降低长时间游戏温度列为这套方案的目标；官方海报以「性能直升，跨代之作」为发布主题。
title_en: OnePlus Ace 7 Set for Oct 29 Launch with Dual-Channel Air Cooling
content_en:
OnePlus has officially scheduled the launch of its Ace 7 series for October 29 at 19:00. Alongside the announcement, the company teased the smartphone's design and highlighted a major breakthrough in thermal engineering.

According to Louis Li, President of OnePlus China, the device introduces a novel "Dual-Channel Glacier Air Cooling System." The design splits airflow into two dedicated streams: one directly cools the main processor to sustain peak performance, while the other channels air across the back panel to keep grip areas cool.

Inspired by desktop graphics card cooling, the system utilizes tower-style fins working in tandem with smart temperature-control algorithms. The solution aims to prevent thermal throttling and maintain high frame rates during long gaming sessions.

title_zh: HHKB 30 周年纪念键盘采用整块铝材外壳，全球限量 300 台
content_zh:
PFU 为 HHKB 诞生 30 周年发布 HHKB Professional Elite 键盘，采用整块铝材切削外壳，全球限量 300 台，其中日本市场 250 台、中国市场 50 台，日本含税售价为 33 万日元。

新键盘以 2006 年的 HHKB Professional HG 纪念款为基础，外壳经过喷砂与阳极氧化处理，采用 Type-S 静音静电容按键和重新设计的内部安装结构。底部刻有独立限量编号，配套的两种支脚可通过安装方向组合，实现四档倾角调节。

Elite 提供英文配列，采用有线连接。日本市场于 10 月 22 日至 28 日接受先行购买资格抽签，12 月 7 日起开放一般销售，先行销售产品预计于 2027 年 3 月起陆续发货；中国的 50 台由当地总代理另行接受申请。
title_en: PFU Unveils Ultra-Exclusive All-Aluminum HHKB 30th Anniversary Edition
content_en:
To celebrate the 30th anniversary of the Happy Hacking Keyboard (HHKB), PFU has revealed the HHKB Professional Elite. Machined from a single block of solid aluminum, this ultra-premium wired keyboard is strictly limited to 300 units worldwide, with 250 allocated to Japan and 50 to China.

Drawing design cues from the legendary 2006 HHKB Professional HG, the anniversary model features a sandblasted, anodized aluminum chassis, silent Type-S Topre switches, and a revamped internal mounting system. Each unit includes a unique serial number on the base, an ANSI US layout, and reconfigurable feet supporting four adjustable typing angles.

In Japan, the keyboard carries a tax-inclusive price tag of 330,000 JPY (around $2,200). A purchase lottery runs from October 22 to 28 prior to general release on December 7, with advance orders expected to ship starting March 2027. China's allocation will be handled separately by local distributors.

title_zh: 智元开源具身推理数据集，让机器人按现场条件决定怎么做
content_zh:
10 月 22 日，智元开源 AGIBOT WORLD 2026 第四期「具身推理」数据集，围绕真实任务中的目标、现场状态与执行约束，训练机器人选择下一步行动。

同一个任务会设置不同的初始条件。例如把迷你吧饮料补到 3 瓶，机器人需要先辨别空瓶、清点数量，再决定回收与补货步骤；从多个抽屉寻找物品时，则要记住已经查过的位置。

本期覆盖属性约束选择、前置条件推理、目标导向搜索、数量与状态推理、长程规划等九类能力，同时提供高层问答、任务阶段、详细动作描述与真机动作轨迹标注，包含成功和错误样本。

智元称，这批数据已用于其即将推出的 Agent 框架与新一代基座模型训练。官方 Hugging Face 仓库采用 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 许可，数据来自真实场景；配套仿真数据另在 GenieSim 项目开放。
title_en: Agibot Open-Sources Embodied Reasoning Dataset for Adaptive Robotics
content_en:
On October 22, AI robotics developer Agibot released the fourth phase of its AGIBOT WORLD 2026 dataset, focusing on "Embodied Reasoning." The dataset is designed to train robots to adaptively plan actions based on dynamic real-world environments, task goals, and physical constraints.

By testing models under varying initial conditions, the dataset teaches robots context-aware problem-solving. For example, when tasked with restocking a minibar, a robot must count existing bottles and locate empties before deciding on removal and replenishment steps. Across nine core capabilities—including long-horizon planning and goal-directed searching—the dataset provides high-level Q&A, stage descriptions, and real-robot trajectory annotations for both successful and failed attempts.

Agibot confirmed that the dataset is already powering the training of its upcoming Agent framework and next-generation base models. Real-world training data is accessible on Hugging Face under the CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 license, while complementary simulation data is available via the GenieSim project.

title_zh: Hugging Face 开源 Carbon-X，让研究人员用对话分析 DNA
content_zh:
Hugging Face 联合北京中关村学院、意大利遗传与医学研究机构推出 Carbon-X。研究人员可以把 DNA 序列放进聊天窗口，询问突变是否可能致病、哪些区域影响基因活动，并获得预测及解释。

这款模型基于 Qwen3-14B 继续训练，实际参数量约 148 亿。团队为文本词表加入 DNA 专用编码，每个 DNA token 对应 6 个碱基，再以 DNA、生物学文本和指令数据训练，使序列与自然语言共用同一个模型。

在团队公布的 5 项 DNA 基准测试中，关闭思考模式的 Carbon-X 平均得分为 66.7%，GPT-6.1 Sol 的对应最高配置为 67.5%。模型权重采用 Apache 2.0 许可，可在本地部署；官方给出的 BF16 部署配置可放入单张 80GB GPU。

团队强调，它尚未经过临床验证，不能用于医疗决策；对缺少上下文的序列可能产生错误解释，长序列生成和精确定位也有局限。
title_en: Hugging Face Open-Sources Carbon-X for Conversational DNA Analysis
content_en:
Hugging Face, in collaboration with Beijing Zhongguancun Academy and Italian genetic and medical research institutions, has released Carbon-X, an open-source model designed to enable conversational DNA analysis for researchers.

By inputting DNA sequences directly into a chat interface, researchers can inquire whether specific mutations are pathogenic or identify genomic regions affecting gene activity, receiving immediate predictions alongside detailed explanations.

Built upon Qwen3-14B with approximately 14.8 billion parameters, Carbon-X incorporates specialized DNA tokenization into its vocabulary, mapping each token to six base pairs. Trained on genomic sequences, biological literature, and instruction sets, the model seamlessly processes DNA sequences alongside natural language.

Across five benchmark tests, Carbon-X scored an average of 66.7% with thinking mode disabled, closely approaching GPT-6.1 Sol's top configuration score of 67.5%. Released under the Apache 2.0 license, Carbon-X can be deployed locally, with its recommended BF16 configuration fitting within a single 80GB GPU.

The development team emphasized that Carbon-X is not clinically validated and should not be used for medical decisions. Additionally, it may misinterpret sequences lacking sufficient context and faces current limitations in long-sequence generation and precise localization.

title_zh: 小鹏 IRON 学会跟着人临时变招，每 0.2 秒重新判断动作
content_zh:
小鹏汽车发布 IRON 人形机器人的交互演示，展示握手、碰拳、击掌时对临时动作变化的响应：人将手掌突然改成拳头，或改变击掌位置，机器人也会调整回应。

据小鹏介绍，升级后的第二代 VLA 大模型已在 IRON 端侧运行。机器人每 0.2 秒根据当前画面重新推理一次，并预测未来 6 秒内的动作变化，以持续观察和调整代替识别一次手势后执行整套动作。
title_en: XPeng’s Humanoid Robot IRON Adapts to Real-Time Motion Changes
content_en:
XPeng Motors has demonstrated new interactive capabilities for its humanoid robot, IRON, highlighting its ability to adapt dynamically to sudden changes in human gestures during real-time physical interactions such as handshakes, fist bumps, and high-fives.

If a human abruptly alters their gesture—such as switching an open palm to a fist mid-motion—or shifts the target contact point, IRON adjusts its movement accordingly rather than executing a rigid pre-programmed response.

This responsive behavior is driven by XPeng's upgraded, second-generation Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model running directly on the robot's hardware. The system re-evaluates visual input every 0.2 seconds and projects action changes over a 6-second window, enabling continuous observation and real-time physical adaptation.

title_zh: 1Password for Agents 发布，密码由用户批准后直接填入网页
content_zh:
1Password 发布面向个人 AI 智能体的 1Password for Agents，让智能体在获得用户批准后登录网站，密码无需进入 AI 模型的上下文，也不交给智能体保存。

当智能体遇到登录表单，会先用专属数字密钥向 1Password 验明身份。用户在自己的设备上查看它申请使用哪项登录凭据、用途是什么，再选择批准或拒绝。获批后，1Password 直接填写网页表单，智能体继续完成原来的任务。

公司正与 Meta Muse、Anthropic Claude Duet、OpenAI ChatGPT Work 和 dots、Grok Bot、Town 等产品推进集成，也列出了 Browserbase、Perplexity 等后续合作伙伴。各项集成进度有所不同，Anthropic 在公告中表示，Claude Duet 将在后续接入 1Password 完成登录。
title_en: 1Password Launches '1Password for Agents' for Secure AI Logins
content_en:
1Password has unveiled 1Password for Agents, a new tool designed to allow personal AI agents to log into websites securely upon explicit user approval. The service ensures sensitive passwords are auto-filled directly into web forms without passing through the AI model's context or being saved by the agent.

When encountering a login form, an AI agent authenticates with 1Password using a unique digital key. Users receive a prompt on their personal device detailing the specific credentials requested and their intended purpose. Upon user approval, 1Password directly fills out the web form, allowing the AI agent to seamlessly resume its task.

1Password is working on integrations with several platforms, including Meta Muse, Anthropic's Claude Duet, OpenAI's ChatGPT Work and dots, Grok Bot, and Town, with future support planned for Browserbase and Perplexity. Anthropic confirmed that Claude Duet will soon utilize 1Password to complete web logins securely.

title_zh: Amp 开放 Orbs 自托管，可在自己的 Mac 和云端运行 Agent
content_zh:
AI 编程工具 Amp 于 10 月 22 日开放 Orbs 自托管，允许用户提供计算资源，由 Amp 将其组织成供智能体工作的独立开发环境。官方给出了 Docker、Apple 容器、Kubernetes 及多种云端环境的接入示例。

本地的 provider 程序主动连接 Amp，接收创建、暂停和删除环境的请求，无需向内网开放入站端口。不同基础设施的恢复能力有所区别：Docker 可以保留磁盘文件，但不能保留暂停前的内存，终端会话和桌面应用不会原样恢复。

自托管不等于整套服务离线运行。Amp 仍负责对话和任务协调，智能体读取的文件内容、命令输出及代码变更仍会经过 Amp，并可能发送给模型提供商。

该功能在 10 月 29 日前对所有工作区免费，此后 Hobby、Individual 和 Teams 计划继续免费，Enterprise 按标准 Orbs 算力价格计费；用户还需自行承担基础设施费用。
title_en: Amp Launches Self-Hosted Orbs to Run AI Coding Agents Locally on Mac and Cloud
content_en:
AI coding tool Amp has launched self-hosted Orbs, allowing developers to provision their own compute resources to run autonomous agents in isolated development environments. The feature supports Docker, Apple containers, Kubernetes, and various cloud setups.

Local provider programs connect outbound to Amp to handle creation, pause, and deletion requests, eliminating the need to expose inbound ports. However, self-hosting is not entirely offline: Amp still manages task orchestration, meaning file contents, command outputs, and code changes are processed through Amp and its underlying AI model providers.

Self-hosting is free for all workspaces through October 29. Following the promotional period, it will remain free for Hobby, Individual, and Teams tiers, while Enterprise users will be charged standard Orbs compute rates alongside their own infrastructure costs.

title_zh: 富士通推出哥斯拉联名笔记本，连鼠标光标都变成脚印
content_zh:
富士通客户端计算于 10 月 22 日推出 FMV Zero GODZILLA EDITION 联名笔记本，与电影《哥斯拉-0.0》合作，即日起在日本官方商城接受订购，计划 11 月下旬开始供货。

这款电脑在纯黑机身顶盖上用黑色墨水绘制哥斯拉，触控板印有背鳍，回车键加入「G-0.0」标志，底部还有专属铭牌。切换到 Windows 的 Godzilla 主题后，三张原创壁纸可轮播，鼠标光标也会变成哥斯拉脚印。

机身采用镁合金外壳，并通过 MIL-STD-810H 标准测试。联名还延伸到电源适配器：同主题的 65W USB-C 适配器会单独销售，同样计划于 11 月下旬供货。

《哥斯拉-0.0》将于 11 月 3 日在日本上映；联名电脑也将在当天举办的哥斯拉节上展示。
title_en: Fujitsu Launches 'Godzilla' Edition Laptop Complete with Footprint Mouse Cursors
content_en:
Fujitsu Client Computing has unveiled the FMV Zero GODZILLA EDITION laptop, designed in collaboration with the movie *Godzilla Minus One*. Pre-orders have opened on Fujitsu's official store in Japan, with shipments expected to begin in late November.

The all-black laptop features a subtle black ink Godzilla graphic on the lid, dorsal fin artwork on the touchpad, a "G-0.0" logo on the Enter key, and an exclusive serial plate on the base. System-wise, the customized Windows Godzilla theme includes three rotating wallpapers and transforms the mouse cursor into Godzilla footprints.

Crafted with a magnesium alloy chassis, the device meets MIL-STD-810H durability standards. A matching 65W USB-C power adapter will also be sold separately starting late November, coinciding with the laptop's public showcase at Godzilla Fest on November 3.

title_zh: Miu Miu 三季度零售销售额降 3%，Prada 品牌增长 1%
content_zh:
Prada 集团公布前三季度收入更新，旗下 Miu Miu 品牌第三季度零售销售额按固定汇率同比下降 3%，Prada 品牌同期增长 1%。Miu Miu 去年同期增长 29%，今年面临较高比较基数及中东市场影响；剔除中东地区后，其第三季度表现大致持平。

集团前三季度净收入为 45.41 亿欧元，按报表汇率同比增长 12%，按固定汇率增长 15%；剔除 Versace 并表和汇率影响后的有机增长为 4%。其中，Versace 贡献净收入 4.41 亿欧元。

集团第三季度净收入按固定汇率增长 11%，有机增长为 1%。美洲仍是表现最好的市场，亚太与日本整体平稳；中东地区较上一季度改善，但仍拖累品牌表现。
title_en: Prada Group Reports Q3 Revenue: Miu Miu Retail Sales Dip 3% Against Tough Comparison
content_en:
Prada Group has released its financial update for the first nine months of the year, reporting a 3% year-over-year dip in Miu Miu's Q3 retail sales at constant exchange rates, while the Prada brand edged up 1%. Miu Miu's decline was largely attributed to a high comparison base—having surged 29% in Q3 last year—and drag from the Middle East market.

For the nine-month period, total group net revenue reached €4.54 billion, up 15% at constant exchange rates (12% reported). Organic growth, excluding currency fluctuations and the consolidation of Versace, stood at 4%. Versace contributed €441 million to overall net revenue.

In Q3 alone, group net revenue grew 11% at constant exchange rates, with organic growth softening to 1%. The Americas led regional performance, Asia-Pacific and Japan remained stable, and the Middle East showed quarter-over-quarter improvement despite remaining a headwind.

title_zh: WALLHACK 推出《剑风传奇》联名鼠标垫，格斯原画铺满玻璃
content_zh:
丹麦电竞外设品牌 WALLHACK 于 10 月 22 日推出《剑风传奇》联名款 SP-005 玻璃鼠标垫，官方海外定价为 139 美元。

图案选用格斯身穿狂战士铠甲、手持屠龙剑的经典画面，将三浦建太郎原作的排线与阴影呈现在 44cm × 51cm 的玻璃表面。黑白画面配红色硅胶底座，附有硬质收纳盒和「烙印」主题贴纸。

产品沿用 SP-005 的无涂层钢化玻璃表面与凹纹网格硅胶底层，总厚度为 3.3mm。《剑风传奇》是三浦建太郎创作的黑暗奇幻漫画，1989 年开始连载，故事围绕格斯在剑、魔法与魔物世界中的经历展开。
title_en: WALLHACK Unveils Limited-Edition Berserk Glass Mousepad Featuring Guts Artwork
content_en:
Danish esports peripheral brand WALLHACK has officially launched its *Berserk* collaboration SP-005 glass mousepad, priced globally at $139 USD.

The design showcases iconic original artwork by Kentaro Miura, depicting Guts clad in his Berserker Armor while wielding the Dragon Slayer sword. Rendered in intricate black-and-white shading across a 44cm × 51cm tempered glass surface, the pad features a striking red silicone base and comes bundled with a hard shell carrying case and themed "Brand of Sacrifice" stickers.

Built on WALLHACK's signature SP-005 architecture, the product utilizes an uncoated tempered glass top layer paired with a textured grid silicone bottom, maintaining a sleek overall thickness of 3.3mm.

title_zh: 《影之刃零》发布最终预告，10 月 27 日开启预下载
content_zh:
《影之刃零》官方发布最终预告，并确认 10 月 27 日 10:00 开启全平台预下载，10 月 29 日 10:00 正式解锁。PS5 实体光碟则将在 2027 年推出。

这款由灵游坊开发的单人动作角色扮演游戏使用虚幻引擎 5，将武侠叙事与机械义肢、工业遗迹等元素结合。玩家扮演心脏遭受重创、仅剩 66 天生命的剑客「魂」，在追杀中追查一场笼罩武林的阴谋。

Steam 官方商店介绍，游戏提供 30 余种主武器和 20 多种特殊武装，战斗融合闪避、格挡、反击与连招；游戏将登陆 PC 与 PS5。
title_en: Phantom Blade Zero Releases Final Trailer, Pre-Downloads Begin October 27
content_en:
S-Game has released the final trailer for *Phantom Blade Zero*, confirming that pre-downloads will open across all platforms on October 27 at 10:00 AM, ahead of its official launch on October 29 at 10:00 AM. Physical PS5 disc editions are scheduled to follow in 2027.

Powered by Unreal Engine 5, the single-player action RPG seamlessly weaves traditional wuxia martial arts with mechanical cyberware and industrial ruin aesthetics. Players assume the role of Soul, a dark hero left with only 66 days to live following a severe heart injury, who must fight his way through relentless pursuit to uncover a deep martial arts conspiracy.

According to its Steam store listing, the game boasts over 30 main weapons and more than 20 special arms, featuring fluid combat mechanics focused on dodging, parrying, countering, and chaining dynamic combos. The title will be available on PC and PlayStation 5.

title_zh: 《天作不合的我们》第三季回归
content_zh:
Netflix 浪漫喜剧《天作不合的我们》（Nobody Wants This）第三季于 10 月 22 日回归，共 10 集。Kristen Bell 与 Adam Brody 继续饰演播客主持人 Joanne 和拉比 Noah，两人在经历上一季的波折后，开始搬进同一间屋子。

主创 Erin Foster 表示，这一季希望让两人在稳定关系中继续保持调情与浪漫，故事会围绕共同生活中的一连串「第一次」展开。

亲友的生活则走向另一个方向：Sasha 与 Esther 分居后重新进入约会世界，Sasha 与 Morgan 的友谊也出现新的张力；随着播客继续发展，Morgan 的事业开始超出 Joanne 的预期。

Justine Lupe、Timothy Simons 与 Jackie Tohn 等原班演员继续回归。
title_en: Netflix Rom-Com Nobody Wants This Returns for Season 3
content_en:
The hit Netflix romantic comedy series *Nobody Wants This* has returned for its 10-episode third season. Kristen Bell and Adam Brody reprise their roles as podcast host Joanne and Rabbi Noah, who take a major step forward by moving in together following the ups and downs of the previous season.

Creator Erin Foster noted that the new season aims to keep the flirtatious romance alive within a stable relationship, focusing on the series of "firsts" that come with cohabitation.

Meanwhile, the surrounding cast deals with major life shifts: Sasha and Esther re-enter the dating scene following their separation, leading to new tensions in Sasha's friendship with Morgan. At the same time, Morgan's career begins to soar beyond expectations as their podcast continues to grow. Supporting cast members Justine Lupe, Timothy Simons, and Jackie Tohn all return.
